'''Heart berry trees''' were a type of [[Tree/Legends|tree]] that grew [[Heart berry|heart berries]] found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. [[Lanoree Brock]] once woke from a [[Dream/Legends|dream]] camped beneath the copse of heart berry trees and thought of the heart berries she and her brother, [[Dalien Brock]], had eaten.<ref name="Into the Void" />

==Behind the scenes==
Heart berry tree were first mentioned in ''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]'', a [[2013]] novel written by [[Tim Lebbon]].<ref name="Into the Void" />
